scope: Read primary full-text locations needed for nuisance projection, local model discrimination, boundary tests and injection-voltage probing. No systematic completeness claim.

sources.title: Optimal discrimination designs
sources.version_used: arXiv:0908.1912v1 electronic reprint; source notes pagination differs from published original

read_locations.detail: Nested extended-model information, local alternatives and noncentrality expressed using a Schur complement.
T-optimality and D1 interpretation when the competing regression model is linear.
KL discrimination criterion includes minimization over alternative model parameters.

sources.supported_use: Background for local squared distance after competitor compensation and for connecting that distance to regular local testing.
sources.own_extensions: The declared positive R/X second-moment matrix, trace task average, average across three structural supports, robust history-centre objective and control-price derivative are derived in this study.
sources.limits: The source does not establish the full AC design guarantee, a topology probability, or validity under rank deficiency and positive-impedance structural boundaries.

sources.title: Asymptotic Properties of Maximum Likelihood Estimators and Likelihood Ratio Tests Under Nonstandard Conditions
sources.journal: Journal of the American Statistical Association
sources.version_used: Scanned published article reproduced in a university course archive; leading page is bibliographic metadata

read_locations.detail: Regularity, distinct distributions, one-sided derivatives and positive definite information assumptions.
Restricted Gaussian estimation describes boundary estimator limits.
Likelihood ratio limits expressed by Gaussian distance to admissible cones; examples differ from ordinary chi-square.

sources.supported_use: Boundary detection requires the appropriate cone and statistical calibration, rather than treating the local information matrix as an automatic chi-square threshold.
sources.limits: Its assumptions do not automatically cover singular nuisance directions, multiple physical explanations or nuisance dimension that grows with the number of time slots.

sources.title: Inverter Probing for Power Distribution Network Topology Processing
sources.version_used: arXiv:1802.06027v3, revised 2019-02-20; first submission 2018-02-16; formal publication version differences not checked

read_locations.detail: Linearized injection-voltage relation and common-path resistance sensitivity.
Probing injection changes, induced voltage data and rank of the probing matrix.
Resistive-network identifiability under leaf probing and voltage measurement at all nodes.

sources.supported_use: Physical background for selecting probing actions through injection-voltage sensitivities.
sources.limits: Linear distribution model and specified measurement coverage; not a guarantee for this study's full AC nuisance-projected design.
